silhouette.reason: Brute head, tusks, topknot, beard and spiked pauldrons read at a glance in every view.
fixes: a clearer neck line under the jaw in SIDE

proportions.reason: Pauldrons sit on the shoulder, but the lame tubes still stand off the torso flank and hang below the bust cut in FRONT and hero.png, reading as stumps beside the body.
fixes: shorten the lame tubes so they end at the bust cut
pull the lame tubes in against the torso flank

materials.reason: The wet gloss on the skin is gone: the green skin is matte with mottling in the portrait hero.png; steel with rivets, brown leather baldric, fur collar and bone spikes separate, but the pauldron steel is a flat grey with a soft plastic highlight and no metal reflection.
fixes: lower pauldron roughness and add a sharp specular streak and edge highlights so the steel reads as metal
roughness variation on the skin (slightly oily forehead)

detail.reason: Scars, rivets, buckle, fur, beard, topknot and lames.
fixes: finer hair strands on the topknot

wear.reason: Face scars are now tan and read as healed scars, not near-white paint, and the pauldrons carry rust blotches and a worn rim; the domes show no clear dents at hero distance and the fur and strap are clean.
fixes: visible dents (height/normal) on the pauldron domes and rust streaks running down from the rivets
dirt on the fur and strap

lod.reason: FAR LOD2 keeps pauldrons as closed shells and the head mass; the skin is faceted and the lames vanish.
fixes: keep the lame stacks as one stepped band at LOD2

technical.reason: 113.9k / 30.3k / 4.0k tris, 4 / 4 / 4 draws: still heavy for a bust.
fixes: halve pauldron lame and fur segment counts at LOD0 (target ~70k)
